validation_notes: The right-side price action from late July into early August shows a sharp drop to ~525 then a bounce, followed by choppy sideways action around 585-650 with no clear convergence. There's no consistent flat support line - lows are irregular (dip to 525, then higher lows near 585-590), and highs are also inconsistent (bounce to 650, pullback, minor bounce). This looks more like consolidation/chop after a downtrend rather than a well-defined descending triangle with a flat support and clear lower highs. I don't see at least two clean, well-spaced touches on a flat bottom trendline paired with a clearly descending upper trendline converging toward an apex. The algorithm's flag seems to be picking up on general downward drift plus recent basing, but the touch points are too loose/scattered to call this a credible triangle.
